title: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say two oil tankers hit sea mines near Oman’s Khasab
desc: Iran's Revolutionary Guards ​said on Thursday that two tankers had exploded and caught ‌fire after hitting sea mines north of Oman's Khasab port while attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz through an unauthorised route.

title: Harnessing social networks and computer models to eliminate HIV transmission
desc: HIV doesn't spread at random. It moves through social and sexual networks, and those same networks can be used to stop it. Dr. John Schneider, Director of the Chicago Center for HIV Elimination, studies how the people around us shape our health, with the goal of ending new HIV transmissions in the United States within a generation.
